sources.entry: Arm Neoverse N2 Core Software Optimization Guide - States the timings and fusion rules of the narrower N line core in Cobalt 100 and Yitian.

summary.title: Arm Neoverse N2 Software Optimization Guide
summary.one_liner: This Arm document describes Neoverse N2 micro-architecture details relevant to software performance tuning, but the page itself only offers a PDF download (version 5.0).
takeaways: The guide covers Neoverse N2 micro-architecture details that affect software performance.
Micro-architectural detail is limited to what is useful for software optimization.
The latest version listed is 5.0; versions 4.0 and 3.0 are superseded.
The page text itself contains no technical content; the material is only available as a PDF download.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the Arm Neoverse N2 Software Optimization Guide. According to the meta description, the document describes the N2 micro-architecture aspects that influence software performance, limited to details useful for optimization. The page states the guide is only available as a PDF, with version 5.0 marked latest and versions 3.0 and 4.0 superseded. The rest of the page text is cookie consent and navigation, so no technical details are visible here.
